# Module `lune_ui_wgpu::frame`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_wgpu`](index.md)

The frame renderer of one target: its uniforms, viewport, text renderers and blur textures,
and the scene → blur → target pass sequence.

The app paints into a [`Painter`](../lune-ui-core/paint.md#struct.Painter) and hands the finished [`Scene`](../lune-ui-core/scene.md#struct.Scene) to
[`FrameRenderer::draw`](frame.md#method.FrameRenderer.draw), which renders it in the [`scene`](../lune-ui-core/scene.md) module's draw order
into any target view at an explicit size and scale: a window surface (see
[`WindowSurface`](surface.md#struct.WindowSurface)) or an offscreen texture (frame dumps). Any
number of renderers share one [`Gpu`](gpu.md#struct.Gpu); everything a draw writes belongs to its renderer, except
the shared glyph atlas of its format and the glyph rasterizer cache.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-wgpu/src/frame.rs:1`

- <a id="method.FrameRenderer.blur"></a>`pub fn blur(&self) -> &Blur`

  The blur stage, for debug dumps of its intermediate textures.

- <a id="method.FrameRenderer.draw"></a>

  ```rust
  pub fn draw(
      &mut self,
      gpu: &mut Gpu,
      text: &mut TextCache,
      scene: &Scene,
      target: &wgpu::TextureView,
      params: FrameParams,
  ) -> Result<(), String>
  ```

  Draws one painted `scene` into `target`, in [`Scene::in_order`](../lune-ui-core/scene.md#method.Scene.in_order)'s order. Each layer with
  backdrop requests is a stop: what is drawn so far is blurred, the requests draw and the
  layer follows. Up to the last stop, and at least to [`Scene::floor`](../lune-ui-core/scene.md#method.Scene.floor), the frame renders
  offscreen; that is blitted to `target` and the rest draws over it.

- <a id="method.FrameRenderer.draw_with"></a>

  ```rust
  pub fn draw_with(
      &mut self,
      gpu: &mut Gpu,
      text: &mut TextCache,
      scene: &Scene,
      target: &wgpu::TextureView,
      params: FrameParams,
      customs: &mut [&mut dyn CustomDraw],
  ) -> Result<(), String>
  ```

  [`draw`](frame.md#method.FrameRenderer.draw) with app-owned draws: each layer's [`CustomItem`](../lune-ui-core/scene.md#struct.CustomItem)s render after the
  layer's acrylic and under shapes and before its images and text, scissored to the item's clip.
  `customs[slot]` draws the items recorded with that slot. Every element of `customs` gets
  one `prepare` call before the first render pass. One queue submit per call.
